sources.title: OSS Personnel Files from Excel
sources.locator: PDF page 49, rows 12-21; Luther W. Brady Jr. through Kute Braho; rendered page visually checked; private identifiers masked

sources.archival_identifier: NAID 604357; data file NAID 1263923; bulk reference copy ASNEF.FIN.DAT
sources.title: Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, ca. 1938-1946
sources.author_creator: War Department; National Archives and Records Administration
sources.locator: Official unrestricted bulk file ASNEF.FIN.DAT; private-identifier comparison for four eligible indexed records and exact-name review for the batch; identifiers withheld
sources.collection_name: Records of the National Archives and Records Administration, Record Group 64
sources.rights_notes: The bulk file was reviewed transiently. No raw record, response body, full identifier, or unrelated record subject is retained in this evidence bundle.

sources.title: World War II Army Enlistment Records: Reference Copy of Technical Documentation
sources.locator: Reference-copy pages 40-42 define fixed-width identifier, name, Army-entry-date, grade, and civilian-occupation fields; user notes describe merged-file limitations
sources.collection_name: Army Serial Number Electronic Files technical documentation
sources.rights_notes: The documentation warns that the merged file includes transcription errors, duplicate identifiers, missing ranges, and no officer records.

sources.title: NARA Compiled Code Lists for the Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File
sources.author_creator: War Department; National Archives and Records Administration
sources.locator: Compiled civilian occupation list; code 266 visually checked
sources.collection_name: Army Serial Number Electronic Files code documentation
sources.rights_notes: The three-digit category describes an occupation at Army entry, not a named employer, workplace, exact trade, or immediate Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies a full name and suffix but no rank, private identifier, note, or nationality. Exact-name official, CIA, military, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, newspaper, institutional, and archival searches did not establish the indexed identity.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 266 recorded at Army entry on 1944-10-16; no employer, workplace, exact role, or start date is named
affiliations.research_notes: Exact private-identifier and name agreement confirms the indexed person. The occupation code cannot support a named employer, workplace, exact duties, or immediate Army-to-OSS pathway.

claims.claim_text: Exact private-identifier agreement confirms the indexed Thomas A Brady identity in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and Army record share the exact private identifier, first and last names, and middle initial; the Army record expands the middle name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through exact private-identifier and name agreement across official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to 1944-10-16; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains masked publicly. The expanded middle name is preserved as a documented variant rather than substituted for the indexed name.

sources.locator_override: Visually checked source row; exact private identifier withheld

claims.claim_text: The official Army entry record places Thomas A Brady in the broad civilian group for policemen and detectives in public service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Code 266 was recorded at Army entry on 1944-10-16 and maps to policemen and detectives in public service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed exact private-identifier and name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry; not a named employer and not proven to be the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: No employer, police department, detective agency, workplace, exact duties, location, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.
